Definition: from G2681; an encamping, i.e. (figuratively) a perch:--nest.
BiblicalUsage: The foxes have holes and the birds of the air have nests, but the Son of man hath not where to lay His head.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the birds have more home than the Lord of heaven did on earth, and that is the price of His coming to us.
